issues.title: The clamped cell carries about half the grip's bending moment: cross-talk and overload from leaning or a hanging bag
issues.evidence: Both cell faces are clamped over the full O25.4 (rays at r=8: 0 mm; front plate z to 11, top-link wall y60-64), in parallel with the leaves. Rotational stiffness: leaves 6.8e6 N.mm/rad, clamped faces on PLA 5.9e6 -> cell share ~47 %. At 50 N down on the grip centre (y219.5), 3.9 N.m goes through the cell, an edge load of 304 N = 1.6 x FS of a 20 kg cell. At 150 N: 11.6 N.m, 4.7 x FS (scripts/flexure_calc.py). The README's 'leaves carry the bending' has no calculation behind it.
issues.fix: Seat each cell face on a O8 x 1.0 raised boss: one on the front plate, one on the top-link front wall, both concentric with the stud. The face clearance outside O8 is then 1.0. That cuts the cell's share to 0.8 %. Keep the stud nuts. Add distances rows for cell face to boss 0 and for the cell rim to the plate/wall >= 0.8. Bench check: hang 5 kg at the grip end and check the HX711 changes by < 2 % FS.

issues.title: Stop gap is fixed at 0.25 without knowing the cell's deflection; engagement 1.3-5.1 x FS nominal, up to 9.6 x worst case
issues.evidence: distances rays 0.25/0.25 and the reviewer nearest-gap row 0.25. Stack worst case +-0.225 (0.025-0.475), and it ignores systematic FDM undersize of the O4.5 vertical hole. The engagement force for a cell FS deflection of 0.05/0.10/0.15/0.20 mm is 5.1/2.6/1.7/1.3 x FS (flexure_calc.txt). Typical safe overload is 1.5 x FS. A damaged cell shifts its zero, so the chair would drive itself.
issues.fix: Make stop_gap = 1.2 x the measured FS deflection. Measure it with the HX711 itself: print cartridges with gap 0.10/0.15/0.20/0.25 (1.1 h each) and pick the one where the reading plateaus between 1.2 and 1.5 x FS under hanging weights. Or fit a 50 kg cell (same puck and studs). Add a stacks row for the upper bound: gap_max x k_cell <= 1.5 x FS.

issues.title: Leaf roots are sharp box unions; stress at the stop roughly doubles
issues.evidence: build_concept.py build_cartridge: leaves are G.box unions with no fillet. Root stress at the stop is 4.6 MPa nominal, 9-12 MPa with Kt 2-2.5. At the worst-case 0.475 gap it is 18-22 MPa, about PLA's printed fatigue range. The flexures row's 7.6 MPa is typed in, and cad check only checks orientation (beam angle 0, interlayer 15).
issues.fix: Add R1.5 fillets at all four leaf roots. They lie in the layer plane, so they print fine. Compute the row's stress from leaf_t, the free length and gap_max.

issues.title: PLA creep and heat at the cell clamp and leaves
issues.evidence: M5 nuts clamp the cell onto 3 + 3.4 mm of PLA (front) and 4 mm (rear). Leaf axial stress is 4.2 MPa at 150 N, carried continuously when a bag hangs on the handle. PLA HDT is about 55 C, so the unit is at risk in a parked car.
issues.fix: Print the cartridge in PETG or ASA. It is the same geometry, and leaf stiffness drops to about 30 N/mm, still under 3 % of the cell. Re-torque both cell nuts after 24 h.

issues.title: Hardware and tools outside the brief, and a heavy cell swap
issues.evidence: BOM: 2 x M5 washer O15 (not in the user's list). README: a 150 mm extension and a 4.0 drill used as a reamer, run through a 45 N/mm compliant tongue whose O4.5 hole sets the gap. A cell swap takes 21 fastener operations and means breaking superglue on both stud threads.
issues.fix: Replace the washer with a printed O15 x 2 PLA washer, or a 9 mm counterbore so the M5 nut bears directly. Ream before the cartridge is cut free, or print the post holes at 4.0 and drive the pin in. Use a drop of hot glue on the nut faces instead of superglue in the threads.

issues.title: Patch cable has no slack
issues.evidence: cables: CAB_Patch_cable path 149.97 for a 150 mm cable (the row allows 155)
issues.fix: Use a 200 mm patch cable and set cable_leads to 200, giving 50 mm of slack; or move the coupler 20 mm toward the board.

issues.title: Parting lines and the clipped window

issues.title: Moving-link claim and documentation gaps
issues.evidence: attempts.md says cad check cannot sweep the moving link, but scripts/split_moving_link.py plus review_rows.json does: first contact is the pin at 0.35/0.35/0.35/0.40 (+-y, +-z) and the fin at 1.05 (+-x). a2_review_rows_verbatim.json is a report, not the rows. The tray overhang note omits the M5 hole and counterbore crowns (78 + 63 mm2). The 0.58 mm tongue wall under the hole is loaded by +z lift overload, not only 'non-structural'.
issues.fix: Have to_cadcheck.py emit PRT_movlink_R/L as check-only objects (or a prismatic joint +-0.35 on a split), and adopt review_rows.json. Move the tongue V tip down 3 mm (tip z -28, post groove deepened 3 mm) so the wall under the hole is 2.0 mm.
